jobs.occupation: Instructor at UMS Skeldar in Linköping
jobs.description:
Combining research and development with advanced technology, UMS Skeldar provides an advanced helicopter platform for the defence and civil security markets. Together, we create an open culture built on Communication, Trust and Commitment. We enjoy having fun together and know that our team is our greatest asset. With us, you are encouraged to develop, take responsibility and grow in your role.
 Keywords: Instructor, Trainer, RPAS, RP, UAV, UAS, Part-66, Helicopter.
We are now looking for a Technical Instructor with a strong technical interest and a genuine desire to teach and develop others. You will be an important part of building our training team and will have the opportunity to help develop our training activities and take Skeldar’s training to the next level.Instructor at UMS Skeldar:
You will be part of the Support department, which supports our customers and end users throughout the entire product lifecycle. The department works with customer support, training, technical documentation and integrated logistics support (ILS), as well as technical issues related to our systems.
You will be part of the Training team, which is responsible for delivering and continuously developing our courses and training programmes. This includes both classroom-based theory and practical elements in the hangar, simulator or ground station.
To operate our system, two pilots and at least one technician who are authorised on the system are required. As an instructor, you will be responsible for training and examining pilots and/or technicians within our system.
You get a solid introduction to the role and the system through internal training, initially working alongside experienced colleagues. The role mainly involves travel to locations within Sweden, but international travel may also occur.
In the role of Instructor, you will:

Take responsibility for training and instructing users in our system

Deliver training courses both in Sweden and internationally

Plan training sessions and prepare training materials

Further develop our training together with the Training team

Conduct evaluations and follow up on training activities

Conduct training primarily in English

Does the position sound interesting? Don't hesitate to apply today!
Are you the one we are looking for?
We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and are looking for someone who thrives in a role where you can combine technical understanding with meeting and developing others. You have strong collaboration skills, take responsibility for your tasks and drive them forward in a structured way. You are communicative and comfortable adapting and communicating technical information to different target groups. As the work environment is dynamic, we also see that you are flexible and enjoy working with varied tasks.
To succeed in the role, we see that you have experience in an educational role, for example as a UAS instructor, flight instructor or other type of instructor within a technically advanced organisation. It is an advantage if you are a trained flight technician, pilot or have another relevant technical education, as well as experience working with technically complex products or systems. A background as a military instructor or UAV operator, or experience with larger UAV systems, is considered an advantage.
The position requires a good command of English, both spoken and written, as the courses are primarily conducted in English. 
We offer:
• An opportunity to be part of a dynamic company that is constantly evolving, where your contribution can make a real difference
• A high-tech product at the forefront of the market
• A close-knit work culture characterised by collaboration and strong commitment
• Activities that promote both social community and health through our Party Committee, Health Committee, Board Game Committee and Women’s Network 
Inquiries:

Workplace: Linköping

Employment type: Full-time

Start: As soon as possible, taking your notice period into consideration

Travel: Travel is required as part of the role

For employment with UMS Skeldar, you must undergo and be approved in accordance with the regulations for security protection in force at any given time. Roles requiring security classification may, where applicable, entail specific citizenship requirements.
We process applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to receiving your application!

Key Responsibilities
Work with clients to improve their business operations and management processes.
Identify areas where businesses can improve efficiency and recommend suitable solutions.
Contribute to the development of business strategies and plans for long-term growth.
Analyze company structures and identify opportunities for organizational improvements and digital development.
Keep up to date with industry developments and apply relevant knowledge to consulting project.

Required Qualifications and Skills
Minimum two years of experience in business development, management, or a leadership role.
Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Economics, or a related field.
Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and organizational skills.
Fluency in English.

This position is offered as a fixed-term project employment for a period of two years connected to a specific client assignment.

About the role
UCS Stockholm is looking for two established Senior Creative who join our Creative Team. 
We are looking for idea-driven candidates with strong conceptual skills and experience creating distinctive creative communications and advertising. At UCS Stockholm, you will work on exciting projects in an international environment.
Responsibilities
Develop ideas and creative concepts.
Create and further develop advertising campaigns.
Work with creative problem-solving.
Collaborate with colleagues and other teams within the agency.

Qualifications
A strong joint portfolio demonstrating conceptual work.
Proven experience working together as a creative team.
Experience with recognized or award-winning campaigns.
Excellent command of English.
Availability to start from January 2027.

Application
Please submit your joint portfolio, individual CVs, and a brief presentation of your team and your experience.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan i Helsingborg söker nu en engagerad och relationsskapande kurator på 50%.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en etablerad organisation med höga akademiska ambitioner och ett tydligt fokus på studiero, struktur och respekt. På IES arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg och inspirerande miljö där både elever och medarbetare kan utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential.

Som kurator hos oss får du en central roll i att bidra till en trygg, strukturerad och inkluderande skolmiljö där elever ges bästa möjliga förutsättningar att nå sina kunskapsmål och utvecklas som individer.

 Vi söker dig som är trygg, tydlig och har en god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbete, har ett lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team. 

Du ingår i skolans elevhälsoteam (EHT), där vi arbetar nära tillsammans med ett tydligt fokus på förebyggande och hälsofrämjande insatser. Du samarbetar dagligen med skolledning, lärare och övrig personal för att skapa en positiv läromiljö präglad av studiero, tydlighet och höga förväntningar.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

- Genomföra individuella samtal med elever
- Arbeta med grupper och klasser i förebyggande syfte
- Bidra till skolans hälsofrämjande arbete
- Handleda och stötta personal i elevärenden
- Samverka med externa aktörer såsom BUP, socialtjänst och ungdomsmottagning
- Delta i nätverksmöten
- Arbeta aktivt med skolans plan mot kränkande behandling och diskriminering
- Ge stöd vid kris- och konfliktsituationer 

Kvalifikationer

- Socionomexamen eller annan relevant högskoleutbildning
- Erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar, gärna i skolmiljö
- God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska 

Vi erbjuder

- En tydlig organisation med starkt fokus på studiero och kvalitet
- Ett välfungerande elevhälsoteam
- Engagerade och professionella kollegor
- Möjlighet att bidra till skolans fortsatta utveckling

Rollen är tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning. Intervjuer sker löpande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.occupation: Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
jobs.description:
Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Employment type: Contract / Full-time
Language: English
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Quality Impression Feature Engineer / Feature Leader to join our client's team in Gothenburg.
In this assignment, you will play an important role in developing and improving the Quality Impression feature for Heavy Duty Vehicles. You will be responsible for defining requirements, evaluating feature status and supporting product development throughout different project phases.
You will also contribute to the long-term development of the feature by improving test methods, supporting simulation activities and contributing to roadmap planning.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an automotive or product development background who is interested in quality, design perception and vehicle engineering.
Key Responsibilities
Handle, define and coordinate requirements related to the Quality Impression feature.

Perform verification, evaluation and testing of models and physical products for Heavy Duty Vehicles.

Assess and monitor feature status throughout different project phases.

Provide technical feedback and collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product development teams.

Drive the development and continuous improvement of feature definitions, methods and processes.

Contribute to the long-term feature strategy and roadmap planning.

Support the development and improvement of test methods and simulation activities.

Prepare and communicate feature status reports to project stakeholders.

Represent the Quality Impression area in discussions and technical reviews.

Required Qualifications
Educational background in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development or a related technical field.

Experience in automotive engineering, industrial design or product development.

Understanding of product quality evaluation and development processes.

Experience in requirements handling, verification, evaluation or testing.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience in Quality Impression or Perceived Quality.

Experience working with Heavy Duty Vehicles or the automotive industry.

Knowledge of CAE (Computer-Aided Engineering).

Experience with visualization techniques and 3D rendering.

Experience with simulation activities and product evaluation.

Experience in feature development, roadmap planning and cross-functional project work.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who is:
Curious, analytical and solution-oriented.

Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.

Confident in communicating technical topics and representing their area.

Collaborative, supportive and open-minded.

Able to work effectively with different teams and stakeholders.

Focused on continuous improvement and delivering high-quality results.

Interested in This Opportunity?
If you have experience in automotive product development, quality evaluation or feature engineering and would like to contribute to the development of Heavy Duty Vehicles, we would be happy to hear from you.
Please submit your updated CV along with a brief description of your relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Polish-Speaking babysitter / nanny in Sundbyberg – 2 afternoons per week
jobs.description:
Since 2008, Solidum Sverige AB / Barnakademin has helped families across Sweden find reliable, caring babysitters. We offer creative childcare in Swedish and specialize in bilingual babysitting, helping children develop their language skills naturally through play and everyday activities.
About the Position
We are looking for a caring, responsible, and enthusiastic Polish-speaking babysitter for a family in Sundbyberg, with two children aged 3 and 6.
The family needs regular help 2 afternoons per week, from 15:00 to 18:00 (6 hours per week). The role involves picking up the children from preschool/school, bringing them home safely, and spending the afternoon together until their parents return.
The family would like their children to maintain and develop their Polish language skills, so we are looking for someone who enjoys speaking Polish with children and making the language a natural part of everyday activities.
Your responsibilities will include:
Picking up the children from preschool/school and accompanying them home safely
Organizing fun, creative, and age-appropriate activities
Playing, reading, singing, and communicating with the children in Polish
Helping with simple afternoon routines and snacks
Creating a warm, safe, and positive environment for the children

Who We're Looking For
We would love to hear from you if you:
Speak Polish at a native or fluent level
Communicate confidently in English or Swedish
Have previous experience caring for children, professionally or privately
Are responsible, reliable, patient, and genuinely enjoy spending time with children
Enjoy creative play, outdoor activities, and engaging children in learning
Are available 2 weekdays per week, from 15:00 to 18:00
Can commit to the position until at least summer 2027

This position is particularly suitable for university students or anyone looking for a rewarding part-time job alongside their studies or other commitments.
What We Offer
A regular part-time position with a family in Sundbyberg
A supportive and friendly working environment
Ongoing guidance and support from our central office
A welcoming community of fellow babysitters
Written references at the end of your employment
Opportunities for additional babysitting assignments with other families
Valuable experience working with children in a bilingual environment

Available Only One Afternoon per Week?
We still encourage you to apply! Even if you cannot commit to both afternoons, we may have other families looking for Polish-speaking babysitters whose schedules match your availability.
Apply Today!
If you love working with children and would enjoy helping them grow up with the Polish language, we would be happy to hear from you!
Please submit your application in English or Swedish, including a brief description of your childcare experience, language skills, and availability.
We look forward to welcoming you to Barnakademin!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
About this vacancy

 

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) är en internationell skolmiljö där engagerade medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för att skapa trygghet, studiero och goda förutsättningar för lärande.

IES Värmdö är en F–9-skola med cirka 610 elever och 68 medarbetare. Skolan ligger i Charlottendal, Gustavsberg, med goda kommunikationer från Stockholm.

Vi söker nu en Student Care Coordinator (SCC) för ett vikariat på ett år, med möjlighet till förlängning. Tillträde är den 11 januari 2027.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Student Care Coordinator arbetar du nära skolledning och elevhälsoteam för att främja elevernas trygghet, välbefinnande och utveckling. Du är en synlig och aktiv vuxen i skolmiljön och arbetar med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 9.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

- Samordna, följa upp och dokumentera stödinsatser för elever.
- Arbeta förebyggande med trygghet, studiero, närvaro och socialt välbefinnande.
- Stödja elever med sociala, psykosociala och beteendemässiga behov.
- Samarbeta med elevhälsoteam, skolledning, lärare och vårdnadshavare.
- Bidra till skolans arbete mot kränkande behandling och genomföra informations- och utbildningsinsatser.
- Vara närvarande i skolans olika miljöer och bidra till en trygg och positiv skolvardag.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och trivs i en internationell och föränderlig skolmiljö.

Vi ser att du har:

- God kunskap om skolans styrdokument och relevant skollagstiftning.
- Erfarenhet eller god kunskap om elevhälsoarbete och förebyggande insatser.
- Förståelse för arbetet med trygghet, studiero och kränkande behandling.
- God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera med elever, vårdnadshavare och externa aktörer.
- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi erbjuder

- En internationell och stödjande arbetsmiljö.
- Engagerade kollegor och ett nära samarbete med skolledning och elevhälsa.
- Möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i elevernas vardag och skolgång.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till recruitment.varmdo@engelska.se.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta maria.segerstedt.varmdo@engelska.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.occupation: Teacher, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Technology, Ages 13 - 16
jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Science/Math Teacher year 6&8

Would you like to work in an international environment with a clear pedagogical policy?

We are now seeking a qualified and creative science & math  teacher for grades 6 & 8. Please note that we are a school with students from Year F-9. 

About you:You must be knowledgeable and passionate about your subject with a teacher qualification to teach science/math . You are a leader in the classroom with the tools to create a calm learning environment. You differentiate your teaching to meet the needs of all your students. Continuous formative feedback to students ensures the students steady development and is a natural part of your teaching.

As a teacher you are flexible and a dedicated team player, and have a passion for not only teaching your subject but also creating a relationship with your students and colleagues. As a mentor to 16 students you will support them to realise their full potential, whatever their background.

Great emphasis is placed on personal qualities.

About the job:The job description includes, besides regular teaching assignments like planning, teaching, grading and monitoring, also mentoring students in one of the classes you teach. You need to be available for meetings with guardians, students and colleagues and actively work to maintain IES values and vision. With us the focus lies on teaching and on a calm environment where the schools routines and rules are followed by both students and staff. A friendly atmosphere and a good collaboration  is the key behind our success. This is also the basis for creating a common thread that guides and supports our students through their schooling and helps them achieve their goals.

Apply now by submitting your resume and a covering letter via IES Careers. Recruitment is ongoing and the vacancy may be filled before the closing date, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to reading your application!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Uppsala är en åk 4-9 skola med ca 740 elever och 75 medarbetare. Skolan har en tvåspråkig inriktning, svenska och engelska, där delar av undervisningen i matte, NO och Engelska och några estetiska ämnen sker på engelska.  

Vi önskar förstärka vårt SVA team och söker nu en legitimerad SVA lärare som kan undervisa nyanlända elever i årskurs 6-9.

Ansvarsområden:

- Samarbeta med kollegor inom SVA för att skapa en stödjande och inkluderande lärmiljö
- Planera, genomföra och utveckla lektioner
- Bedöma elevens framsteg, ge konstruktiv feedback och föra noggranna dokumentationer
- Mentorskap för elever i en av de klasserna du undervisar
- Delta i professionell utveckling och bidra till skolans gemenskap

Vem är du?

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet och legitimation i SVA
- Du kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
- Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar undervisningen samt arbetar för att skapa en trygg och stimulerande lärandemiljö.
- Du är en lagspelare och ser ett värde av samarbete inom ditt arbetslag och tycker om att arbeta med människor i en internationell skolmiljö.
- Du tar ansvar för att systematiskt dokumentera, analysera, utvärdera och följa upp elevernas kunskapsutveckling.
- Du tar egna initiativ och har ett tydligt ledarskap i klassrummet.
- Du är klar och tydlig i din kommunikation och har förmåga att motivera och entusiasmera elever till att ta till sig ny kunskap.
- Du har goda kunskaper i IKT som pedagogiskt verktyg.
- Du brinner för utveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Tjänsten är 80%, visstid, fram till sommaren 2027. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats.  Ansökningar via mail kommer inte att beaktas.

jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Uppsal är en åk 4-9 skola med ca 740 elever och 75 medarbetare. Skolan har en internationell inriktning och undervisningen bedrivs både på engelska och svenska. Skolan verkar för att lärande och kunskap sätts i första rummet. Eleverna lär sig ta ett personligt ansvar för sin egen utveckling och arbetsmiljö och att respektera sina skolkamrater, lärare och sig själva.

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare till olika mindre undervisningsgrupper i matematik, årskurs 6 - 8. Undervisningen i matematik följer den svenska läroplanen LGR22 och i tjänsten ingår delat mentorskap för en årskurs 7 klass.

Ansvarsområden:

- Planera, genomföra och utveckla lektioner för barn i behov av extra stöd i matematik
- Bedöma elevens framsteg, ge konstruktiv feedback och föra noggranna dokumentationer
- Mentorskap för elever i en av de klasserna du undervisar
- Samarbeta med kollegor för att skapa en stödjande och inkluderande lärmiljö
- Delta i professionell utveckling och bidra till skolans gemenskap

Vem är du?

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet och legitimation att undervisa matematik
- Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av undervisning i liten grupp.
- Du brinner för utveckling och ett kollegialt arbetssätt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Hos oss är studiero viktigt, därför behöver du vara trygg i din roll och ha förmågan att skapa ett gott arbetsklimat både bland elever och kollegor.  Du har en positiv människosyn och har förmåga att skapa goda relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. 

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 6 månader, vårterminen 2026, med början 11 januari 2027. Tjänsten är 80%, över 4 dagar (ledig dag är torsdag). Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

Rekryteringen sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan (CV, personligt brev och lärarlegitimation) via vår IES Careers-webbplats alternativt recruitment.uppsala@engelska.se 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.
Who we are looking for
Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.

Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.

Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.

EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.

Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.
The role
As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.
Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.
What we offer
Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.
